label: 2020s
description: The current decade, still being written: whatever's newest in the crates lives here.

label: 2010s
description: Streaming took over, but the records that mattered still got pressed on wax.

label: 2000s
description: The decade vinyl was supposed to be dead. Instead it just went quiet for a while.

label: 1990s
description: Grunge, golden-age hip-hop, and the last decade before the CD really took hold.

label: 1980s
description: Bigger drums, brighter synths, and sleeves that were half the point.

label: 1970s
description: Everything in the catalogue pressed or released between 1970 and 1979: the decade the record shop as we know it took shape.

label: 1960s & earlier
description: Everything that came before: the roots most of what's upstairs in the shop grew out of.
